claims.claim: Israel's standard VAT rate is 18% in 2026 (raised from 17% on 1 January 2025; a proposed bump to 19% was rejected and it stayed at 18%).

claims.claim: VAT reporting is bi-monthly for businesses with annual turnover up to ₪1,775,000 for the year beginning 01.01.2026, rising to ₪1,805,000 from 01.01.2027, and monthly above the threshold. Reports and payments are due within 15 days of the end of the reporting period.

claims.claim: The חשבוניות ישראל allocation-number (מספר הקצאה) regime requires an allocation number for tax-deductible business invoices above ₪10,000 (ex-VAT) from 1 January 2026, dropping to ₪5,000 from 1 June 2026, or the buyer cannot reclaim the VAT input. The threshold stepped down from ₪25,000 (2024) and ₪20,000 (2025).

claims.claim: Income-tax advances (mikdamot) are paid and reported by the 15th of each month for the previous month; when the 15th falls on the payer's weekly rest day it shifts to the next business day; and when paying through the Tax Authority website the deadline is the 19th of the month at 18:30.

claims.claim: Bituach Leumi contributions for the self-employed are paid on the schedule of the payment vouchers Bituach Leumi sends; a bank standing order is debited on the 22nd of the month for the previous month, and the date shifts around Shabbat and holidays. It is not the 15th.

claims.claim: Iron Swords Memorial Day was approved by the Israeli government on 17 March 2024 (a cabinet decision, not a Knesset law), is marked annually on 24 Tishrei with two state ceremonies at 11:00 and 13:00, and moves to Sunday 25 Tishrei when 24 Tishrei falls on Shabbat. In 2026 it falls on 5 October.

claims.claim: The Israel Tax Authority defers filing and payment dates during emergencies. In 2026 the February monthly report and the January-February bi-monthly report were deferred to 26.03.2026, and March reports filed by 29.04.2026 were not charged penalties, linkage differences or interest.

claims.claim: Under the עסק זעיר regime the annual turnover ceiling is ₪122,833 for 2026; such a business receives an automatic flat 30% expense deduction and in most cases is not required to pay income-tax advances.
claims.raw_snippet: אסור שמחזור העסקאות השנתי (ולא הרווח!) בעסק יעבור את הסכום של 122,833 ₪ (נכון לשנת 2026)

claims.claim: An עוסק פטור may have annual business turnover of no more than ₪122,833 (2026), charges no VAT and cannot reclaim input VAT, has no periodic VAT report, and declares its previous calendar year's turnover by 31 January. The 2025 declaration was deferrable to 30.04.2026.
claims.raw_snippet: רק מי שמחזור ההכנסות השנתי שלו מהעסק (לא הרווח) אינו עולה על 122,833 ₪ (נכון לשנת 2026) רשאי להיות עוסק פטור

claims.claim: עסק זעיר is an income-tax status while עוסק פטור is a VAT status; an עסק זעיר is not necessarily an עוסק פטור, and an עוסק מורשה can also be an עסק זעיר.

claims.claim: A business cannot be treated as an עסק זעיר, even below the ₪122,833 ceiling, if it employs workers, does not keep acceptable books, had income in the tax year that was not from personal exertion, received part of its income from its own employer, or was attributed income from a תאגיד שקוף.
